_doc: Benign event corpus for scripts/validate_rules.py (--benign). EVERY RoboDR rule of the event's type is evaluated
against every event; any hit that is not in the event's 'allow' list fails CI, and so does an 'allow' entry
that no longer fires. 'allow' is only for maintenance actions whose alert is the audit trail, or for
documented, accepted noise; each needs a 'reason'. Header fields default to image '', pid 1000,
parent_pid 1, uid 0, gid 0, container null. Events are modelled on the exec/open sequences of the named
tools (launch_ros, rosbag2, CMake 3.28 FindPython, gcc, initramfs-tools mkinitramfs, kmod depmod,
glibc ldconfig, dh-python py3compile, systemd >= 255); they are NOT captures from a running pulsard.
Generated once; edit the JSON directly.
